title: Capsule Design Requires Relationships And Evals

source_refs.source_id: sources.books.Systems Thinking & Decisions.Thinking in Systems — Donella Meadows
sources.books.Testing, Measurement & Experiments.Lessons Learned in Software Testing — Cem Kaner, James Bach & Bret Pettichord

payload.given: A knowledge capsule design reference includes general guidance and ordinary operational headings but omits source model, relationship map, downstream integration, failure modes, and eval scenarios.
payload.should: The validator rejects the reference with capsule-design-missing-sections before the capsule can be treated as a portable handoff.
payload.expected_failure: The handoff passes because it is readable and has generic headings, even though it cannot improve downstream skill or Jamie Brain behavior deterministically.

eval_intent.knowledge_claim: Capsule design references must include relationship and eval surfaces, not only prose guidance.
eval_intent.behavior_under_test: Observable KnowledgeOS validator behavior when a capsule-design artifact omits relationship mapping and eval coverage.
eval_intent.failure_mode: The validator accepts a polished but behavior-weak capsule-design reference.
eval_intent.expected_agent_move: The validator rejects the capsule and points to the missing capsule-design sections.

source_trace.extracted_principle: Capsule design requires relationships, downstream integration, failure modes, and eval scenarios.

bad_answer_pattern: The validator accepts the capsule because ordinary operational headings are present.
good_answer_pattern: The validator rejects the capsule with capsule-design-missing-sections.

proposed_evals_yaml_case.given: A knowledge capsule design reference includes general guidance and ordinary operational headings but omits source model, relationship map, downstream integration, failure modes, and eval scenarios.
proposed_evals_yaml_case.should: The validator rejects the reference with capsule-design-missing-sections before the capsule can be treated as a portable handoff.
proposed_evals_yaml_case.prompt: Use the relevant KnowledgeOS capsule-design rules to judge the handoff.

acceptance.value: The capsule is valid because it has ordinary operational headings.

skill_lift_target.before_failure: The validator accepts a readable but behavior-weak capsule-design reference.
skill_lift_target.after_behavior: The validator rejects capsule-design references that lack relationship and eval surfaces.
skill_lift_target.observable_delta: The negative fixture is rejected by the repo validator.

title: Skills SDK Handoff Must Not Overclaim Ingest

title: Consumer Receipt Must Reject Stale Digest
